Are you interested in learning Python Polars? Working with Martien Lubberink PhD, I have created a fast-paced introduction to the basics here: [The basics of data analysis](https://iangow.github.io/era_pl_book/py-intro.html)

Why Python Polars? Because it's a very fast "next generation data frame library" [Wes McKinney] that can handle multi-gigabyte data files with ease.

One challenge with Python has traditionally been setting things up. Please provide feedback on the (draft!) instructions here: [Python Polars setup and templates](https://github.com/iangow/era_pl_templates/)

(Thanks to Konstantin Pavlenkov for providing detailed feedback on an earlier version of the materials linked to above.)

\#polars
